project_scope.note: B014 approved Texas ash and green ash. Mexican ash and Gregg's ash remain explicit range holds.

study_strategy.warning: In Central Texas, do not separate Texas ash and green ash by leaf silhouette alone; UT PRC notes co-occurrence and possible hybridization.

quick_key.if: 5–7 leaflets + glaucous/white-reticulate wax below + small samara with mostly terminal wing
5–7(9) leaflets + broader shield-shaped scar + larger samara with wing extending well down body
